description: Java class 'RomAttributeParser' providing static methods for parsing various attribute types from ROM XML, including endianess, hex strings, storage types, scale types, table types, byte values, integer values, file sizes, and float conversions.

classes.name: RomAttributeParser
classes.description: Final class with static methods for parsing ROM XML attributes.

methods.name: parseEndian
methods.description: Parses endianess string ('big' or 'little') and returns corresponding constant.

methods.name: parseHexString
methods.description: Parses a hex string (e.g., '0xFF') into an integer.

methods.name: parseStorageType
methods.description: Determines storage type (float, uint, int) and returns corresponding constant or size.

methods.name: parseStorageDataSign
methods.description: Returns true if storage data is signed (starts with 'int'), false otherwise.

methods.name: parseScaleType
methods.description: Parses scale type ('inverse' or default linear) and returns corresponding constant.

methods.name: parseTableType
methods.description: Parses table type ('3D', '2D', 'X Axis', 'Y Axis') and returns corresponding constant.

methods.name: parseByteValue
methods.description: Extracts a byte value from input byte array with specified endian, address, length, and sign.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Converts an integer to a byte array with specified endian and length.

methods.name: parseFileSize
methods.description: Parses file size string (e.g., '10kb', '2mb') into integer bytes.

methods.name: floatToByte
methods.description: Converts a float to a byte array with specified endian.

methods.name: byteToFloat
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a float with specified endian.
